questions.text: Is there a clear, documented 3-5 year strategic vision for the enterprise?
Does the leadership team meet regularly to review KPIs and adjust strategy?
Is the organization's structure aligned with its strategic goals?
Does the enterprise maintain a minimum of 3-6 months of operating cash reserves?
Are financial statements reviewed and reconciled monthly?
Is there a diversified revenue stream (no single client > 20% of revenue)?
Are there documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all core processes?
Is there a formal quality control process in place for deliverables?
Are resource allocations optimized based on data-driven demand forecasting?
Does the enterprise have a clearly defined unique value proposition (UVP)?
Is there a formal process for monitoring competitor movements and market shifts?
Is the pricing strategy reviewed and adjusted based on market value annually?
Is there a systematic process for collecting and acting on customer feedback?
Does the enterprise track and maintain a formal Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) metric?
Is there a formal customer onboarding and retention program?
Is there a documented performance management and reward system for employees?
Does the organization have a structured onboarding and training program?
Is employee turnover within industry norms for the last 24 months?
Is there a formal board or advisory council that provides oversight?
Are internal controls in place to prevent fraud and mismanagement?
Is the enterprise compliant with all local and international regulations?
Is there a dedicated budget and time allocated for R&D or innovation?
Does the organization encourage and reward calculated experimentation?
Is there a formal process for turning new ideas into viable products/services?
Is the core technology stack scalable and up-to-date?
Is there a comprehensive data backup and disaster recovery plan?
Are business processes automated to reduce manual error and latency?
Is there a formal risk register that identifies and monitors key threats?
Are there contingency plans for the loss of a key executive or partner?
Is there a formal process for managing third-party vendor risk?
Does the enterprise have a documented environmental sustainability goal?
Is there a formal CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) program in place?
Is the business model designed for long-term viability over short-term gain?
Is there a formal AI adoption strategy aligned with business goals?
Does the staff possess the basic AI literacy required for their roles?
Are AI tools currently integrated into core operational workflows?
